title: refactor(metadata,objectql,cli): one spelling of the residual-picklist refusal and of two registration refusal envelopes
body:

_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XNLFamdrWU3ohqRH6ptUBYs)_

Fixes #28275
Fixes #28160

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：三处「同一个拒绝写了两份」各收成一份。① 组合栈顶层「没人引用的 picklist」拒绝：判定（哪些列表、按哪些字段算「被引用」）和文案搬进 `@objectstack/metadata/picklist-references` 的 `unreferencedResidualPicklists`，引擎的 `manifest` 服务和 `os validate` / `os build` 都读它；引擎原来的 picklist 字段遍历也搬过去，objectql 的 `picklist-resolution.ts` 改为转出。② 权限集 `packageId` 归属拒绝的信封、③ `views:` 非容器条目的 422 文案：从 `engine.ts` 导出，顶层残余注册直接调用，不再各抄一份。
- **为什么改**：卡 #28275（分诊 6537443627）与 #28160（范围扩大 6526088897，来自合约复核 6526074825）：两处拷贝只靠一个启动对拍测试或文字断言维持一致，改一边就会悄悄漂移。
- **风险与回滚**：纯搬移，不改任何启动结果、错误码、状态码和文案（逐字节）；`--json` 发现形状不变。新增公开导出（metadata 新子路径 + objectql 根转出），故 `Clause-②: yes (widening)`，`patch`。回滚即 revert。
- **先看**：`packages/metadata/src/picklist-references.ts`（新判定与遍历）；`packages/objectql/src/plugin.ts`（`unreferencedResidualPicklistRefusal` 与 `registerUnclaimedTopLevelItems` 的两处调用）；`packages/cli/src/utils/picklist-references.ts`（`findUnreferencedResidualPicklists`）。
- **两分钟验证**：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql exec vitest run src/registration-refusal-one-spelling.test.ts` → 7 passed（引擎与两扇门的抛出值逐字段等于唯一导出函数的返回值）。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位落地（合约复核由席位做）。

## What changes

Measured on `origin/main` `23d1303d` before any edit: `unreferencedResidualPicklistRefusal` was module-private at `packages/objectql/src/plugin.ts:238`, composing its own text over `collectManifestPicklistReferences`; `packages/cli/src/utils/picklist-references.ts` restated the walk (`fieldPicklistNamesOf`) and the words (`residualPicklistWording`); `permissionSetOwnerRegistrationRefusal` was module-private at `packages/objectql/src/engine.ts:4793` and `plugin.ts` rebuilt its envelope inline; the `views:` container-shape 422 text was spelled in both `engine.ts` and `plugin.ts`.

### #28275 — one residual-picklist judgement

- **New subpath `@objectstack/metadata/picklist-references`** (`packages/metadata/src/picklist-references.ts`, own `exports` entry and tsup entry, after the `./view-container-name` precedent). It holds:
  - the manifest picklist walk the engine already used, moved verbatim from `packages/objectql/src/picklist-resolution.ts`: `collectPicklistReferences`, `collectManifestPicklistReferences`, `collectManifestPicklistNames`, `collectManifestPicklistExtensions`, and the `PicklistReference` / `OrphanPicklistExtension` types;
  - `unreferencedResidualPicklists(residual, bodies)`: takes the residual answer (`unclaimedTopLevel`, read structurally so the entry never loads the package root) and the package bodies, and returns `{ owner, picklists: [{ name, field, index, wording }], wording }` or `undefined`. `wording` is `{ judgement, prescription, text }`; the top-level `wording` is the engine's one plural sentence, each list's `wording` is a door's finding. The sentence is byte for byte the text the engine composed before.
- **Engine.** `unreferencedResidualPicklistRefusal` is now `picklistMetadataError(unreferencedResidualPicklists(residual, bodies).wording.text)`. `picklist-resolution.ts` re-exports the moved walk, so `registry.ts`, the boot audit and the install door import it from the same place as before, and there is one walk, not two. `@objectstack/objectql` re-exports `unreferencedResidualPicklists` and its four types from the root, as it does `viewContainerNameRefusal`.
- **Doors.** `findUnreferencedResidualPicklists` (`os validate` step 2d, `os build` step 3a-bis) maps the judgement's lists to findings; `fieldPicklistNamesOf` and `residualPicklistWording` are gone. The finding keeps `severity`, `rule`, `where`, `path: picklists[i]`, `message`, `hint`.
- **Boot-parity file** shrinks to a smoke check: one refused stack and one control, still byte-comparing the boot's message with the door's `message + ' ' + hint`. The seven stacks it dropped are pinned at least as close to the code: on the judgement (`packages/metadata/src/picklist-references.test.ts`), at the door (`picklist-references.test.ts`, whose residual pins are unchanged) and at the engine (`manifest-service-residual-objects.test.ts`, unchanged).

### #28160 — one envelope per registration refusal

- `permissionSetOwnerRegistrationRefusal` is exported from `engine.ts` (module export only; not on any package entry). `registerUnclaimedTopLevelItems` calls it instead of rebuilding the `VALIDATION_ERROR` / 400 / `issues[]` envelope.
- New `viewsEntryNotContainerRefusal(itemName, sourceLabel, ownerId)` in `engine.ts` holds the `views:` container-shape refusal's `INVALID_METADATA` / 422 envelope and text. The body seam (`registerMetadataCollections`) and the residual registration (with the `manifest` label) both throw it.
- `plugin.ts` drops its now-unused `ASSEMBLED_VIEW_ITEMS_KEY` and `judgePermissionSetOwnerBinding` imports.

Not changed: what the boot refuses or serves, every refusal's code, status and text, the `--json` finding shape, `packages/spec/**`.

## Tests

- New `packages/objectql/src/registration-refusal-one-spelling.test.ts` (7 tests): the objectql re-export `toBe` the metadata function; the boot's residual-picklist refusal equals `unreferencedResidualPicklists(...).wording.text` and the envelope, for one and two lists; the residual registration's permission-set refusal and `views:` refusal each equal, field for field (`message`, `code`, `status`, `httpStatus`, `issues`), what `engine.ts`'s exported function returns, and so does the body seam's (`registerApp`) for the same input.
- New `packages/metadata/src/picklist-references.test.ts` (12 tests): which residual lists are refused and which fields count as naming one (body object in both spellings, body `objectExtensions`, body nested `plugins[]`, residual object; a body `picklistExtensions` entry names nothing), the singular and plural words, the owner word `none` in angle brackets for a stack with no id.
- `packages/cli/src/utils/picklist-references.test.ts`: one new pin, the door's findings equal the judgement's lists, locations and per-list words.
- `packages/metadata/src/serializers/typescript-serializer-annotation.test.ts`: its export-entry count control moves 6 → 7 for the new entry (the loop it guards now visits it too).
- Unchanged and green: the engine's residual pins (`manifest-service-residual-objects.test.ts`, including the #28153 permission-set and `views:` pins), `picklist-references.test.ts`'s existing pins.

<details><summary>Ablation — each single-source pin goes red on a re-inlined copy with one changed word, and only it</summary>

Run with `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (mutation landed and restore proven by blob hash and an empty `git diff HEAD`), on head `3ba35659` (the source files are byte-identical at the final head; only a test count moved after it):

| Leg | Mutation | Red | Still green |
| :-- | :-- | :-- | :-- |
| A | `plugin.ts`: the engine composes the residual-picklist text inline again, "missing" → "absent" | `registration-refusal-one-spelling` × 2 (one list, two lists) | 65 of 67 in the two objectql files, including every residual-picklist phrase pin |
| B | `cli/.../picklist-references.ts`: the door's `message` re-inlined, "missing" → "absent" | the new door pin + the boot-parity smoke check | 33 of 35 |
| C1 | `plugin.ts`: the `views:` refusal rebuilt inline, "wrap it" → "enclose it" | `registration-refusal-one-spelling` residual `views:` pin | 66 of 67, including the #28153 `views:` pin (it quotes the first sentence only) |
| C2 | `plugin.ts`: the permission envelope rebuilt inline around the same message, issue `code` `custom` → `invalid` | `registration-refusal-one-spelling` residual permission pin | 66 of 67, including the #28153 permission pin (it matches the message) |

The "still green" column is why the pins are new: the behaviour pins quote phrases, so a second copy that drifts outside those phrases passed them.
</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **File surface.** The claim lists `packages/metadata/src/**`, `plugin.ts`, `engine.ts`, the objectql re-export, the CLI file and its tests, and changesets. This diff also touches `packages/metadata/package.json` and `tsup.config.ts` (the new subpath's entry, the precedent's shape) and `packages/objectql/src/picklist-resolution.ts` (it re-exports the moved walk, so the walk is not spelled twice). The `picklist-resolution.ts` amendment was asked of the seat before the edit.
- **Clause-②** measured `yes (widening)`: a new subpath with new exports on `@objectstack/metadata`, and a root re-export on `@objectstack/objectql`. Nothing is newly refused or accepted, so no `(narrowing)` arm and `Metadata-protocol: none`; `patch` on all three packages per AGENTS.md Post-Task step 3.
- The two `engine.ts` exports are module exports only (`@objectstack/objectql`'s entries are `.` and `./core`, neither re-exports them), so they add no published surface.
- The door's walk is now the engine's. It differs from the old CLI copy only on shapes the stack parse refuses before the door runs (a name-keyed `objectExtensions`, an array inside `plugins[]`), so no parsed stack changes outcome.
